title: WWE Blocks Jade Cargill's 'That B****' Catchphrase, Undertaker's Boneyard Casket Hits Auction - NewsBreak
text:
By Sap Sinha ,
40 minutes ago
Booker T claims Jade Cargill vs. Rhea Ripley is the match he wants to see most at WrestleMania 42.
During a recent edition of his “Hall of Fame” podcast, Booker T called it “a marquee match, a main event anywhere in the world.” He also noted Cargill has huge fan momentum right now.
The two meet for the WWE Women’s Championship on Night Two, April 19, in Las Vegas.
Booker T said, “Without even a shadow of a doubt, it’s gonna be Jade Cargill and Rhea Ripley. Those two together, that’s a marquee match. That’s a main event anywhere in the world. We’re going to get a chance to see exactly what Jade Cargill is made of. All the talk, all the doubters, all the naysayers get a chance to shut all them up. That’s what I’m looking forward to more than anything. I’m looking forward to Rhea Ripley, man. She’s the star, major, major, mega star. So for me, both of these ladies together, that’s a Molotov cocktail. It is about to blow up in Las Vegas, Nevada.”

“Whatever happens is going to happen as far as that goes. But I do see Jade Cargill having some major momentum right now. The fans are loving the hater. For me as a promoter, I’m gonna run with it for a while. I just want to see a banger with the ladies. I want to see them go out there, really tear the house down. This right here, this is the biggest women’s marquee match that we’ve seen in quite some time. And if they go out there and pull it off, my God, it’s gonna be good. I’m looking forward to Jade Cargill going out there and really bringing it to another level. I’m looking forward to seeing Rhea go out there and pull the Rip Tide out and have a great match.”
Jade Cargill loves her “That B****” catchphrase as it is a big part of who she is on WWE television. But while she can say it on TV, WWE has completely blocked her from putting it on any merchandise.
During a recent appearance on “The Joe Budden Podcast,” Cargill revealed that she pitched glasses, shirts, and other items featuring the phrase. However, every single one got rejected. She even said WWE limits how many times she can say it at all.
Cargill made these comments just days before she defends the WWE Women’s Championship against Rhea Ripley at WrestleMania 42 in Las Vegas.
WWE has put the casket from The Undertaker’s legendary Boneyard Match against AJ Styles at WrestleMania 36 up for auction.
The casket, signed by both Undertaker and AJ Styles, is now live on WWE Shop and runs until April 24.
Fans attending WrestleMania 42 in Las Vegas can also view it in person at WWE World.
